audit.why: 61.97% over 71 games matches the prose: you own the early and mid lane on sustained DPS, level 6 is the only swing, and the side-lane duel stays yours because his engage is telegraphed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike and the cooldown breakdown treat Infinite Duress as a permanent threat with no timer.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s. Between casts there is a minute and a half at rank 1 in which he has no engage that survives Miasma — that is when you take plates and prio.
audit.corrected: Put 110s at rank 1 into the cooldown breakdown so 'track it' becomes a countable thing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) 'a grounded Warwick with no dash on his basics' and 'his only gap-close is a telegraphed R leap' — Jaws of the Beast (Q) is itself a lunge on an 8s rank-1 cooldown, so Miasma grounds two abilities here, not one. (b) Primal Howl is never mentioned in either layer, and it is the single biggest reason your Twin Fang chain whiffs value.
audit.why: Riot text: Jaws of the Beast — 'Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.' Primal Howl — 'Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.'
audit.corrected: Named Jaws of the Beast as a second grounded dash, and told you to hold fangs through Primal Howl's 2.5-second damage reduction rather than dumping into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Grievous Wounds against a kit with three separate heals.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger heals below 50% and triples below 25%, Jaws of the Beast heals for damage dealt, and Infinite Duress heals through the channel. Poison DPS without anti-heal is exactly what he is built to survive.
audit.corrected: Added Oblivion Orb to the extended-trade want.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad warns about 'standing in Infinite Duress range with Miasma on cooldown'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that scales with his bonus move speed — there is no fixed range to stand outside of, so the advice is unactionable. The real bad trade is spending fangs into Primal Howl.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the bad trade around Primal Howl's damage-reduction window.

edits.before: Once you have Q+E, prime with a Noxious Blast then chain Twin Fangs every time he steps up to last-hit — the cooldown refund off the poison lets you fire E again almost instantly, and his Blood Hunt only ramps once you're low, so staying healthy starves his sustain.
edits.after: Once you have Q+E, prime with a Noxious Blast then chain Twin Fang every time he steps up — the refund off the poison fires E again almost instantly. Watch Primal Howl (E, 15s): it hands him 2.5 seconds of damage reduction, so hold your fangs until it expires instead of feeding it.

edits.before: Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs — a grounded Warwick with no dash on his basics loses every extended trade to your sustained damage.
edits.after: Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang — grounded, Warwick loses both Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress, and every extended trade with them.

edits.before: Prime with Noxious Blast (Q) and spam Twin Fang (E) in extended trades — the CD refund off poisoned targets gives you near-continuous DPS that out-races his Blood Hunt sustain
edits.after: Prime with Noxious Blast (Q) and spam Twin Fang (E) in extended trades, but buy Oblivion Orb — Eternal Hunger, Jaws of the Beast and the Duress channel all heal him back through your poison

edits.before: You stay ahead in the straight 1v1 all game — he's a melee drain bruiser whose only gap-close is a telegraphed R leap, and your Miasma grounds it while Petrifying Gaze cancels it if you face the dash. The real danger is map-wide: a fed Warwick flanks from fog and lands Infinite Duress before you can turn, and once the suppress locks you, his channel heal snowballs the fight. Keep vision so you're never caught walking, hold R for his engage rather than spending it as poke, and you out-DPS him in every fair duel.
edits.after: You stay ahead in the straight 1v1 all game — his gap-closers are Jaws of the Beast on 8s and a telegraphed R leap, and Miasma grounds both while Petrifying Gaze cancels the ult if you face the dash. The real danger is map-wide: a fed Warwick flanks from fog and lands Infinite Duress before you can turn, and the channel heal snowballs the fight. Keep vision so you are never caught walking, carry Grievous Wounds, hold R for his engage, and you out-DPS him in every fair duel.

edits.before: Miasma is the anti-dash button — ground his engage and the dive kit becomes a farm bot.
edits.after: Miasma is the anti-dash button — ground Jaws and Duress and the dive kit becomes a farm bot.

edits.before: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — Lock-on suppress — track it before every step-up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Miasma has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Warwick Infinite Duress: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1, a lock-on suppress; track it before every step-up. - Jaws of the Beast is an 8s lunge Miasma also grounds. - Primal Howl is 2.5 seconds of damage reduction into a fear.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Infinite Duress range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — or dumping fangs into Primal Howl's 2.5 seconds of damage reduction.
